name: ripple
title: Ripple
description: Waves spread out from the center and fade, in a loop, with optional content centered above them. Pure CSS keyframes.
label: yui540/css-animations
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>

props.name: children
props.description: Content centered above the waves (an avatar, a status dot). With children, the root is no longer aria-hidden.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the waves on their current frame. Without it they loop forever.

props.name: ...props
props.description: Every native div attribute. className sizes the stage (default w-full max-w-80, square); aria-label names it.

a11y: Decorative by default: the root is aria-hidden. Pass aria-label (or aria-labelledby) and it becomes role="img" with that name.
Loops forever: pass paused from a visible control (WCAG 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide). The demo's toggle is a native button with aria-pressed.
Reduced motion: opacity only. The waves keep their full size and only pulse.
